title: Delete warns when a card is used by reference
description: Fabio 2026-09-25: the gallery delete dialog gets an extra red line when the card is referenced elsewhere (a Mix recipe, a Flow Reuse input, a GIF, an extend source...), e.g. 'This card is used by 2 mixes. Delete anyway?'. Global, not Mix-only. Deleting stays allowed; a Mix then shows the clip red, like DaVinci (MPI-917).
